description: This file defines a class Opencart\System\Library\Image that handles image processing tasks such as loading, resizing, rotating, watermarking, cropping, filtering, and saving images. It supports various image formats like PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP and relies on the GD extension for image manipulation.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: A class providing various image manipulation functionalities such as loading, resizing, rotating, cropping, watermarking, filtering, and saving images using the GD library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Loads an image from a file, retrieves its properties, and initializes internal variables.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the filename of the loaded image.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the loaded GD image resource or object.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: getBits
methods.description: Returns the number of bits per pixel of the image.

methods.name: getMime
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current image to a specified file with given quality, supporting various formats.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the image to specified dimensions while maintaining aspect ratio according to the default parameter.

methods.name: watermark
methods.description: Applies a watermark image to the current image at a specified position.

methods.name: crop
methods.description: Crops the image according to specified top-left and bottom-right coordinates.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates the image by a specified degree and applies a background color.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies a filter to the image using variable arguments.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Adds text to the image at a specified position, with size and color (not fully visible in provided chunk).

methods.name: html2rgb
methods.description: Converts a hex color code to an RGB array (not visible in provided chunk).

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another image onto the current image at a specified position with given opacity.
